feed_summary: Threat actors have been observed unsuccessfully attempting to exploit the newly disclosed PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to rope infected systems into a Mirai botnet variant called Potassium, as it emerges that weaponizing the flaws may be harder than previously thought. title: PHP2Shell Exploit Attempts Hit Millions as Attackers Try to Deploy Mirai Malware
